text:
nina: kicking off bring-up for v5-alpha-quant (bld-421). big cost win but some quality deltas on small-answers and intent-classification slice. want to settle an automated gating plan before inviting traffic.

cale: drop the smoke numbers pls.

nina: smoke summary (smk-20260325-07):
```
baseline: prod v4.1 (bld-399)
candidate: v5-alpha-quant (bld-421)
samples: search small-answers N=30k, intent N=8k, rerank N=10k
metrics:
  small_answer_exact: 0.672 -> 0.655 (delta -2.55%, p=0.03)
  intent_F1: 0.913 -> 0.901 (delta -1.32%, p=0.09)
  latency_p95: 145ms -> 110ms (win)
```

omar: small_answer_exact p=0.03 is worrying. our policy (prod gating) says immediate rollback if core customer-facing metric drops >=2% with p<=0.05. that would trigger.

cale: slight nuance: this model is quantized and has improved hallucination profile on some longdocs in offline eval. can we design a conditional routing + sequential test so critical routes keep prod while low-risk routes get tested?

nina: proposed rollout:
  1) route-level pinning: intents and critical helpdesk routes pinned to v4.1 for now
  2) start an SPRT-based canary on small-answers for 6h with initial alpha=0.05 beta=0.2, stop early on strong evidence of harm/benefit
  3) 2% AB on 'faq' traffic for 12h while SPRT runs on small-answers slice
  4) immediate rollback if SPRT accepts H1 (harm) OR small_answer_exact delta <= -2% & p<=0.05 in any hourly snapshot
  5) if SPRT inconclusive after 6h keep quiet-burn at 0.5% for 48h with EWMA(alpha=0.25) soft guard (threshold -1.2%)

omar: I like SPRT for early stopping. remind ops that sequential testing needs continuous bucketing — can't cherry-pick post-hoc.

telemetry-bot: smoke smk-20260325-07 produced artifact: gs://rwd-smokes/smk-20260325-07.tar.gz. bootstrap CI quick-run: small_answer_exact p=0.031, delta -2.55%.

cale: given p~0.03 i'm leaning conservative: block wide rollout but allow the SPRT + route-pinned AB. add structured examples logging for first 5k small-answer queries and user feedback probe (thumbs up/down).

nina: example routing JSON I'll apply:
```json
{
  "pins": [
    {"route": "intent.*", "version": "v4.1"},
    {"route": "helpdesk.*", "version": "v4.1"}
  ],
  "experiments": [
    {"route": "faq.small_answer", "variant": "v5-alpha-quant", "pct": 0.02}
  ],
  "guards": {
    "sprt": {"metric": "small_answer_exact", "alpha": 0.05, "beta": 0.2, "h_threshold": -0.02},
    "hourly_snapshot": {"metric": "small_answer_exact", "delta": -0.02, "p": 0.05},
    "ewma": {"metric": "small_answer_exact", "alpha": 0.25, "threshold": -0.012, "window_mins": 2880}
  }
}
```

ci-bot: preflight smoke archived. recommend adding top-10 disagreement payloads and ask analytics team to enable quick concordance job.

cale: approval from me if ops pins routes and SPRT is wired into monitors + alert to oncall with auto-rollback hook. also require a manual checklist item: run offline hallucination eval on 1k known longdocs and post diff.

omar: approved. also request a dedicated "opt-out" toggle for enterprise/dedicated customers so we don't auto-apply experiments there.

ops-bot: scheduling canary smk-20260325-07 at 2026-03-26T03:00Z with config rollout-5101234567.json. alerts: sprt-alerts, hourly-snapshot; rollback webhook enabled. notifications to #eng-ml and #release-war-room.

nina: thanks — i'll add structured logs + concordance job now and post dashboard link. will follow up with SPRT stop criteria doc.

cale: quick note for the runbook: if SPRT stops for harm, auto-rollback and capture 2k failing samples for triage; if inconclusive but EWMA warning fires, keep quiet-burn but escalate to model-owner for manual decision.

nina: will add to runbook. closing thread for prep.
